北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力 6 级，体感 2℃，风寒感重，请注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has a strong 6-level wind and feels like 2℃. Dress warmly!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波湿度 100%，体感 15℃。请注意防潮，小心路滑和感冒。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has 100% humidity, feels like 15℃. Mind the dampness, slippery roads, and stay healthy.
宁波.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海大雾弥漫，湿度 95%！出行请注意交通安全和防潮。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy with 95% humidity! Drive safely and stay dry.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 27℃，有点热呢！多云天气，也要注意补充水分。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 27℃, quite warm! Stay hydrated even if it's cloudy.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 28℃，暖洋洋的！多云天气，记得防晒补水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 28℃, lovely and warm! Remember sunscreen and hydration.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天湿润，体感 15℃。注意防潮，出门记得带伞哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and humid, feels like 15℃. Mind the dampness and take an umbrella.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京风力 5 级，体感 10℃。阴雨湿冷，请注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has 5-level winds and feels like 10℃. It's damp and chilly, stay warm!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天微凉，体感 12℃。注意适时添衣，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool, feels like 12℃. Dress accordingly and keep a good mood.
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉风力 4 级，体感 11℃。阴冷有风，请注意防风保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has 4-level winds, feels like 11℃. It's chilly and windy, stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 10℃，有点凉。天气干燥，记得多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 10℃, a bit cool. It's dry, so remember to drink more water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天体感 15℃。早晚温差大，请注意适时添衣。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Mild, but mind the temp change between day and night.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -11℃，寒意十足！全副武装，注意防寒保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -11℃, very cold! Bundle up and stay warm.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -4℃。注意防风保暖，别让皮肤干燥。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold, feels like -4℃. It's windy, stay warm and moisturize.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明小雨，体感 8℃。风力 4 级，出门带伞，注意防风保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has light rain, feels like 8℃. It's windy, take an umbrella and stay warm.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 4级

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴天，体感 22℃，非常舒适！享受阳光，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels like 22℃, very pleasant! Enjoy the sunshine.
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛小雨，体感 8℃。风力 4 级，带好雨具，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain, feels like 8℃. It's windy, bring your umbrella and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -4℃，阴冷湿润。注意保暖，别让寒气入体哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -4℃, damp and chilly. Stay warm and keep the cold out.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦晴天，体感 25℃。阳光明媚，外出记得防晒补水哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is sunny, feels like 25℃. Bright sunshine, remember sunscreen and hydration.
漳浦.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿润，体感 15℃。注意防潮，体感微凉别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and humid, feels like 15℃. Stay cozy and mind the dampness.
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
